mapper.select: SELECT cai.id, ifnull(cai.company_id, cei.company_id) AS orgId, ifnull( cei.abbreviation, '公司' ) AS orgName, ai.accountTypeId, ai.accountTypeName, ifnull(cai.account_item_id, ai.accountItemId) AS accountItemId, ai.accountItemName, ai.type, ifnull(cai.inservice, 1) as inservice FROM clinic_account_item cai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ai.id AS accountItemId, ai.`name` AS accountItemName, ai.type, a.id AS accountTypeId, a.`name` AS accountTypeName FROM account_item ai LEFT JOIN account_type a ON ai.account_type_id = a.id ) ai ON cai.account_item_id = ai.accountItemId LEFT JOIN clinic_ext_info cei ON cai.company_id = cei.company_id WHERE cai.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id AS accountTypeId, a.`name` AS accountTypeName, ai.id AS accountItemId, ai.`name` AS accountItemName, ai.type, cai.id, IFNULL( cai.inservice, 1 ) as inservice FROM account_item ai LEFT JOIN account_type a ON ai.account_type_id = a.id LEFT JOIN clinic_account_item cai ON cai.company_id = #{orgId} AND ai.id = cai.account_item_id WHERE ai.id = #{accountItemId}

SELECT cai.id, ai.accountTypeId, ai.accountTypeName, IFNULL(cai.account_item_id, ai.accountItemId) AS accountItemId, ai.accountItemName, ai.type, IFNULL( cai.inservice, 1 ) AS inservice FROM clinic_account_item cai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ai.id AS accountItemId, ai.`name` AS accountItemName, ai.type, a.id AS accountTypeId, a.`name` AS accountTypeName FROM account_item ai LEFT JOIN account_type a ON ai.account_type_id = a.id ) ai ON cai.account_item_id = ai.accountItemId WHERE cai.account_item_id = #{accountItemId} and cai.company_id = #{orgId}
